## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与改后行为

## Validation actually performed / 实际完成的验证

List commands/environments and results; identify checks not run. / 写明命令、环境、结果及未运行项目。

## Data and compatibility / 数据与兼容性

Describe schema, project migration, snapshot, or numerical changes if relevant. / 如涉及数据结构、项目迁移、快照或计算，请说明。

## Review checklist / 审阅清单

- [ ] Demo and scientific-analysis boundaries remain explicit. / 演示与真实分析边界清晰。
- [ ] No private experimental data or unauthorized third-party assets are included. / 未包含私人实验数据或未获授权素材。
- [ ] Relevant Chinese/English text and documentation are updated. / 已同步相关中英文与文档。
- [ ] New dependencies/reused content have recorded licenses. / 新依赖或复用内容已核对许可。
